PROFILE
UX/UI designer with 4 years of experience designing web and mobile products for
fintech, e-commerce and agency clients. I work end to end: discovery interviews,
journey mapping, wireframes, high-fidelity UI in Figma and usability testing.
For the last two years I have owned a shared design system used by four product
squads. Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams across European time
zones. Native Portuguese, fluent English (C1).

SKILLS
Design: Figma (advanced, components, variants, auto layout, variables), FigJam,
  prototyping, wireframing, interaction design, responsive web, mobile UI (iOS and
  Android patterns), visual design, information architecture
Design systems: component libraries, design tokens, documentation, Storybook
  handoff, accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Research: user interviews, usability testing (moderated and unmoderated),
  surveys, card sorting, journey mapping, A/B test design with product analysts
Collaboration: design critiques, workshops, Jira, Notion, working with product
  managers and front-end engineers
Technical: basic HTML and CSS, Maze, Hotjar, Google Analytics
Languages: Portuguese (native), English (C1), Spanish (basic)

UX/UI Designer
